sql_query:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN o_p.payment_installments = 1 THEN 'Single-payment'
    WHEN o_p.payment_installments > 1 THEN 'Installments'
  END AS payment_installments_group,
  ABS(AVG(o_p.payment_value)) AS avg_payment_value,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments o_p ON o.order_id = o_p.order_id
WHERE o_p.payment_value IS NOT NULL
  AND o_p.payment_installments IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN o_p.payment_installments = 1 THEN 'Single-payment'
    WHEN o_p.payment_installments > 1 THEN 'Installments'
  END
ORDER BY payment_installments_group;
